stem:
Yash shines a torch at a plane mirror. An incident ray meets the mirror at point O. A dashed line at O is drawn at 90° to the mirror. The reflected ray leaves O. Yash keeps a flat sheet under these rays.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: The incident ray, the dashed line, and the reflected ray all lie in the same plane.
The dashed line is the reflected ray because it leaves point O.
Only the incident ray and the reflected ray must share a plane; the dashed line may leave that plane.
The same-plane rule applies only for curved mirrors, not for this plane mirror.

teacher.key_rationale: The incident ray, the normal (dashed line at 90°), and the reflected ray all lie in the same plane for reflection at a plane mirror.
